review: D-20 adversarial review (read-only workflow wf_8a930942-ee5, 4 finders + 4 skeptics) of 9927fbe..46955af

confirmed.title: Reload replay of an in-flight submit treats 429/503 as final: forgets the key, unlocks the card and says "nothing was booked"
The "couldn't reach the restaurant / Try again" alert and chatPending outlive a completed booking and replay a stale pre-booking request
Chips on the latest reply stay enabled during a booking POST; the tap adds a guest bubble and then is silently dropped
No tests for the D-20 client safety fixes (replay lock, chat/submit exclusion, stale-reply drop, reload Try again) or for dedupe eviction and error handling
confirmed.disposition: partly fixed: E2E for the reload replay, Try again after a reload, chips during a submit and a same-task double tap; unit tests for requestDeduper. The stale-reply drop (generation counter) still has no E2E.

confirmed.title: Request dedupe caches 429 rate-limited/queue-full results for 120 s

Constraints from earlier turns (allergy, avoid, diet, budget) are lost when the model's prefs leave them out. Rule 8's per-field wording invites this, and resolvePrefs replaces the previous prefs outright
Allergy flag is never passed to the chooser: an allergy-only guest is described as 'none stated', and allergens other than dairy/nuts/egg can't be filtered

Ingredient requests ('anything with prawns / black lentils?') have no prefs field, so the stated ingredient is ignored: menu shows section chips, the recommend fallback lists the first three dishes on the menu
confirmed.disposition: partly fixed: the fallback shows the dishes retrieval found first. A menu-intent ingredient question still gets the section list (prompt rule 1 routes 'anything with prawns?' to recommend).

confirmed.title: The only recommend example sets mild:true; the live model adds 'mild' to requests that say nothing about spice, which filters out spicy dishes and carries into later turns
confirmed.disposition: fixed in code instead of the prompt: a model 'mild' without a spice word in the guest's message is dropped. No second example was added (prompt budget).

confirmed.title: Sticky prefs (course, budget, diet) make the 'Show me the menu' chip after a no-match a dead end with no chips
'cheaper'/'another' (relation) has no code backstop, although the follow-up chips send fixed texts
Rule 4 changed without being recorded (and contradicts itself): 'use only numbers that appear in them: never repeat the guest's own numbers'; the test files it under v4
interpretJson dropped the maxLength truncation guard for the chooser: a reply the grammar cut at 400 characters is accepted and shown
Static-prefix test doesn't vary the new per-turn inputs, and no test renders non-null prefs or suggested lines
ScriptTurn's prefs default plus the non-strict TurnSchema let a misspelled prefs key in a scripted case quietly become null
A confirmed booking wipes the stored food preferences, so a nut allergy stated earlier is forgotten, and no eval mirrors the reset
INV-05 never checks recommendation prose, so the unsupportedClaimsShown gate cannot see the chooser's text
The double-click E2E test passes without the new synchronous in-flight guard, and the other client guards have no test
SC-REC-007 claims to test preference memory, but its scripted model supplies the diet, so nothing in code is tested
LV-REC-008 accepts faq or menu intents, but notIds only inspects recommendation cards
LV-REC-013 ("Is that vegan?") checks only that the bot did not abstain, so a false 'yes' passes
A recommendation passes mustCiteAny through an alternative row, even when the lead dish does not answer the question
The "Find a table" follow-up appears during a booking in progress and clears the branch and selected slot
Follow-up chips stay enabled during a reservation POST, and tapping one leaves a guest bubble that never gets a reply
groundedAnswerCorrectness is now credited by code-built menu lists and no-fit replies
recommendationValidity is weighted by dishes shown, and the recommend latency mixes 1-call and 3-call turns
confirmed.disposition: partly fixed: scored once per turn. Recommendation latency still mixes 1-call (no match) and 3-call turns; it is report-only.

confirmed.title: LV-REC-005 turn 2 does not check the course, so "similar to that, but cheaper" passes with any cheaper dish
The 'another' exhausted reply produces ungrammatical guest text
New region landmarks repeat names across turns, and the alternatives heading reads as a sub-heading of the lead dish
Diet-word check passes if any dish on the card has the label, not the dish the reply describes
Any negation word in a sentence skips every diet check, and 'no dairy'/'without nuts' claims are never checked
Stated allergy/diet is not kept in code across turns: model prefs replace the previous ones wholesale
Allergy detected but allergen not mapped: groundnut/walnut/hazelnut, gluten allergy, lactose intolerance
Fish/shellfish/soy allergies cannot be filtered; the fallback shows Amritsari Fish Fry to a fish-allergic guest
Negated diet and spice words are read as the constraint itself, and re-added every time the guest drops them
Allergen-safety check misses common safety promises ('safe for you', 'a safe bet', 'contains no nuts')
A clarifying reply (pick null) skips the hype, safety and diet checks
'Cheaper' no-match text says no dish exists when one is already on the card
Persisted prefs (including course) hijack the 'Show me the menu' chip; the no-match escape chip repeats the dead end
Budget regex reads non-price numbers as a rupee cap and overrides the model
Model-invented constraints are accepted unchecked (live run: 'light' and 'not too expensive' became mild)
Price pairing misses a wrong price when name and price counts differ or the price is in a separate clause
'Cheaper' is enforced only if the model sets relation and a previous suggestion exists; the reply's 'cheaper' claim is unchecked
confirmed.disposition: fixed: the chip texts are read in code, and 'cheaper' falls back to the first dish last shown. A reply that says 'cheaper' when the guest didn't ask is not checked.

confirmed.title: Hype check misses common invented-popularity phrasing
'veg' on its own (and 'vegetarians'/'veggie') is not read as a diet constraint
Reply may name dishes that are not on the card and not in the fit list
'under/below/less than ₹N' is applied as at most N
confirmed.disposition: not changed (deliberate): 'under ₹400' keeps ₹400 dishes, as the reply's 'up to ₹400' says. Recorded in D-20.

confirmed.title: Avoid-allergen trigger is message-wide, so liking an ingredient reads as avoiding it

refuted.title: No test pins keeping a constraint across turns: SC-REC-007 scripts the model itself keeping the diet, and the resolvePrefs unit test only covers a constraint restated in the latest message
